item.title: IG appoints DCP Anthony Placid to replace Hundeyin as new Police PRO.
item.description: The Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, has appointed Deputy Commissioner of Police Anthony Placid as the new Force Public Relations Officer (PRO) of the Nigeria Police Force.Placid will take over the position from Benjamin Hundeyin, who previously served as the spokesperson for the police.The announcement was made in a statement released on Sunday by Hundeyin at the Force Headquarters in Abuja. item.title: “If you can't see my worth, then you have no place in my life” – Dele Odule sends strong message to people in his circle.
item.description: Veteran Nollywood actor Dele Odule has shared a strong message directed at people within his inner circle, stressing the importance of loyalty and mutual respect.In a post shared on his Instagram page, the Yoruba movie star said he does not hesitate to distance himself from anyone who does not value him, no matter how important the person may have once been in his life.According to Odule, the moment he realizes that he is not important to someone, he immediately treats the person as a stranger.

item.description: A fire erupted at the Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation building in Abuja on Monday morning, causing major traffic congestion around the Federal Secretariat.The incident occurred around 8:00 a.m., prompting emergency responders to rush to the scene as thick, dark smoke billowed from an upper floor of the multi-storey building.
